dialogues.speaker: Message Board
dialogues.text: "The Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament finals are upon us! Haniyyah, the beast tamer veteran, is going up against the powerful Golden Comet and Silver Companion!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The competition is too jam-packed. There are too many matches going on at the same time. I haven't even had the time to get to know the background of all the competitors, and we're already at the finals, ugh!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If there are more competitions after this one, please don't schedule the matches so closely together! And maybe consider revival matches to give competitors who had a bad day a second chance!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Thank you for your support! The staff at Nilotpala Cup has received your suggestions."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The first ever Nilotpala Cup hoped to deliver the joy of 'Beast Taming' and 'Fungus Battle' to everyone. Due to limited resources, we apologize and ask for your understanding for any inconvenience."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "The next season of the Nilotpala Cup is already in the works. We have plans to adjust the tempo of the matches and the rules of the competition. Please feel free to sign up and participate if you are interested."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "With all of your wisdom and input, we are confident that the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament will be an event that takes Sumeru by storm!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "It's finally the finals. I've been waiting for an evenly matched fight."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "To be honest, the matches prior to this one were a little boring. They were too friendly! There was no excitement... I'd rather see the competitors give it everything they've got. I want them to go for each other's throats! An exciting competition should be fierce and filled with rivalry!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: (There seem to be responses to this particular comment...)

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "I completely disagree! This is a competitive event, not a brawl! The cute Fungi should be quickly tended to after being wounded in the match. And you're here talking about spilling blood!?"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "If it's excitement that you're looking for, you can go pick up one of the bounties posted by the Corps of Thirty and go fight the vicious Fungi in the wild!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Not only will that satisfy your needs, it'll also bring great joy to us!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Someone mentioned before that we can use tamed Fungi to help with security. I find that to be a great idea. It can even be applied to other areas as well!"

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "They can help with protecting cargo shipments, crop irrigation, or even mining. The possibilities are endless."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Obviously, it's all on the premise that the 'beast taming' techniques are steadily passed on to more people, and the cost of Wisdom Orbs is reduced."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Also, we'll have to monitor and solve any issues regarding the reliability of the Wisdom Orbs once its application is introduced on a large scale..."

response.speaker: Message Board
response.text: "Maybe the organizers should hire the competitors as instructors to teach the general public about the usage of the orbs... Hmm, that could be a great idea."
